reference.description: Original BF16 inputs and weights through PyTorch layer_norm and linear, bypassing Transformer Engine quantization and packing; every stored K/V element is compared.

fp8.operand_format: E4M3 forward operands with delayed per-tensor scaling
fp8.rationale: The independent full-cache aggregate and global-maximum ceilings are one E4M3 half-ULP at a normal binade (2^-4).

nvfp4.operand_format: E2M1 values with per-16-element E4M3 block scale and FP32 tensor scale
nvfp4.rationale: The independent full-cache aggregate and global-maximum ceilings are one E2M1 half-ULP at a normal binade (2^-2); finite and overflow checks remain mandatory.

pairwise_envelope.description: After both independent full-cache gates pass, compare the raw FP8 and NVFP4 caches with atol=max_abs(shared BF16 reference)*(0.0625+0.25).

qualification.claim_boundary: Passing establishes this lab's arithmetic full-cache gate on the recorded stack. It does not establish attention, model, task, or application quality.
